title: Mobility Equipment Retail Price List for Self-Pay Sales
content:
# Retail Price List — Mobility Equipment Sold Outright to Self-Pay Patients

Summit Ridge Home Medical sells every Mobility Equipment class outright to a self-pay patient. The list gives, per class:

- **Cash price** — the cash price of the class sold outright to a self-pay patient (USD).
- **Delivery fee** — the non-refundable delivery fee on a self-pay sale (USD).
- **Return window** — calendar days after delivery within which a self-pay chair may be returned for a refund; 0 when not returnable.
- **Restocking fee** — the restocking fee withheld on a self-pay return (percent).

| Class | Cash price (USD) | Delivery fee (USD) | Return window (calendar days) | Restocking fee (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 329.00 | 25.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 499.00 | 25.00 | 30 | 15 |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 749.00 | 25.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 2899.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 3995.00 | 149.00 | 14 | 20 |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 11500.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the list

- **Classes with no return window.** Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) and Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) show a window of 0, meaning they are not returnable, and a restocking fee of 0.
- **Shortest window among returnable classes.** Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823), at 14 days, with the highest restocking fee, 20 percent.
- **Hypothetical order total.** A self-pay order for a High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) lists a cash price of 749.00 and a delivery fee of 25.00.
